coordinate_frame: metres, right-handed global XYZ, z vertical, local room rotated around global origin
survey_grid: 0.5 m spacing, 0.25 m local XY phase, both heights at each valid XY location
ap_acquisition: independently identified A and B channels; A+B reuses both acquisitions
delay_unit: seconds in native archive; metres in estimator view
native_angles: degrees; azimuth about z; polar elevation from +z, not elevation above horizon
native_precision: NIST JSON writer casts channel arrays to IEEE single before serialization; preserved verbatim in gzip
noise_rng: NumPy PCG64 with independent semantic seed per channel/sample/track/level
native_ray_identity: privileged visualizer path coordinates; never estimator features
reference_source_scope: real AP plus every geometrically valid first/second order source in the empty survey-time room, regardless of sampled visibility or power
